AdamSmith wants the window measured to ensure that any new air-conditioner they consider purchasing will fit properly within the dimensions of the basement. Since he's recommending a split-type air-conditioner, which is significant in size and efficiency, it's important to know the exact space available in order to select an appropriate model that matches the basement's size and provides adequate cooling capacity. The basement's dimensions, approximately 15 feet by 20 feet, are provided to help in this decision-making process. Measuring the window may also be relevant if the air-conditioner setup involves an external unit that needs to be placed outside the basement window.
